description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams used for filtering search parameters related to employee emergency contacts. It extends a base FilterParams class, specifies allowed sort fields, and provides getter and setter methods for employee number and contact name.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for filtering search results of employee emergency contacts based on employee number and name, with default sorting by contact name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'eec.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the search filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the search filter.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name filter for the emergency contact.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name filter for the emergency contact.
